postCreateCommand.installDependencies: npm --prefix src/backend ci && npm --prefix src/frontend ci && npm --prefix dev ci && npm --prefix docs ci --ignore-scripts && npm exec --prefix dev -- playwright install --with-deps chromium
postCreateCommand.installMdbook: set -eu; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64|amd64) mdbook_target=x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu ;; aarch64|arm64) mdbook_target=aarch64-unknown-linux-musl ;; *) echo "Unsupported mdBook architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; mdbook_archive="$(mktemp)"; trap 'rm -f "$mdbook_archive"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; curl -fL "https://github.com/rust-lang/mdBook/releases/download/v0.5.4/mdbook-v0.5.4-$mdbook_target.tar.gz" -o "$mdbook_archive"; tar --no-same-owner -xzf "$mdbook_archive" -C "$HOME/.local/bin" mdbook
